metaDescription: Send money from one of your bank accounts to another Horizon user.
title: Send money
subtext: Send money from one of your bank accounts to another Horizon user. Fill in four short steps, then confirm.
noAccountBody: To send money, you need a bank account in Horizon. Connect a bank to get started.
cannotSend: Only US bank accounts connected through Plaid can send money, and only in test mode. Choose one of those accounts.
receivingCodePlaceholder: Paste the code they shared with you
receivingCodeHint: Ask them for their receiving code. They can copy it from any bank card in their Horizon account.
stepNoteHint: Both of you will see it
formAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
formSender: Choose the account to send from.
formReceivingCode: Paste the receiving code the other person gave you.
confirmBody: From {from} to {to}. Once sent, this money cannot be taken back.
confirmNo: No, go back and change it
reviewHint: You will be asked to confirm before anything is sent
errReload: Reload the page and try again.
errInFlight: This transfer is already being sent.
errTooMany: Too many transfers in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errAmountFormat: Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most two decimals.
errAmountMax: Transfers are limited to {max} at a time.
errNoteShort: Add a short note (at least 4 characters).
errSenderCannot: This account cannot send transfers. Choose a Plaid-linked US account.
errReceiverCannot: This account cannot receive transfers yet. Only Plaid-linked US accounts are supported.
errSameAccount: Choose a different account to send to.
errDeclined: The transfer was declined by the payment network. Check the amount and try again.
warnNotSaved: The transfer was sent, but Horizon could not save it to your history yet. Please do not send it again.
